observation: chdman 0.289 verified the supplied CHD successfully. The decoded track has 292815 raw sectors. ISO9660 names volume XENOGEARS with exactly SYSTEM.CNF;1 and SLUS_006.69;1. SYSTEM.CNF explicitly names this boot executable. The executable contains a North America marker at file offset 0x4c. Both-endian ISO fields and bounds were checked.
interpretation: These bytes establish a reproducible North American research profile and boot identity, not an exhaustive content catalog, disc sequence, retail revision label, clean-dump provenance or game behavior.
